players.product: Liquid cooling, power distribution units, enclosures and electrical connection/protection for AI data centers

quarterly_data.signal: nVent leased additional manufacturing space at a second location in Blaine, Minnesota: the new 160,000 square-foot site expands capacity to manufacture data center liquid cooling solutions, is expected to begin production in the first half of 2027 and employ more than 200 people. It is nVent's third data center liquid cooling capacity expansion in three years, adding more than 400,000 square feet of new space overall. The company says it has deployed more than two gigawatts of liquid cooling and collaborates with leading chip manufacturers and hyperscalers. Sara Zawoyski, President, nVent Systems Protection: the expansion 'reflects the growing need for liquid cooling solutions and the strength of customer demand'.
quarterly_data.figure: 160,000 square-foot site; production expected in the first half of 2027; more than 200 people; more than 400,000 square feet of new space over three expansions; more than two gigawatts of liquid cooling deployed
